steps.name: UpdateProgress [render][databind][dynamic][templates] first request: the panels, the proxy's script run, a panel made in code

UpdateProgress [viewstate] a button outside triggers the second panel
UpdateProgress [viewstate] a postback trigger in the panel: a full postback
UpdateProgress [templates][render] while a slow request runs: the progress shown
UpdateProgress [templates][viewstate] after the slow request: the progress hidden
UpdateProgress [viewstate] the timer started: one tick, then stopped
UpdateProgress [viewstate] a history point, then the browser's back: the script manager's Navigate

UpdateProgress [visible][viewstate] a hidden panel shown with what was set while hidden
